title: $32 million NIH grant expands decades-long Alzheimer’s study
summary_en: The Healthy Aging and Senile Dementia program, led by WashU Medicine neurologist John Morris, MD, is one of the longest-running Alzheimer’s studies. The new funding will allow investigators to reach new populations with a focus on prevention.
